comment: Retained regression record for fixture replays whose spec-expected outcome diverges from observed endpoint behavior. Each entry names the mandated behavior, the owning vector for the fix, and is exercised verbatim by gmcp_req_203_001_05_interop — an entry that drifts from observed behavior fails the replay.

divergences.disposition: fixture authored the per-request protocol version as params.protocolVersion; the wire contract carries it under params._meta (io.modelcontextprotocol/*). Corrected fixture positive/server-discover-2026-07-28-meta.json retained; original kept verbatim per fixture immutability.
MCP 2026-07-28 requires rejecting a null request id; the served endpoint drops it without a JSON-RPC -32600/id:null response. Retained regression for the JSON-RPC work package.
an unparseable stdio line is dropped without a -32700 parse-error response; same rejection-path regression as the null-id case.
